title: Property of the descended morphism, [stacks-project]
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set, let $(S_\lambda)_{\lambda\in I}$ be an inverse system of schemes with affine transition morphisms, and let $S=\varprojlim_{\lambda\in I}S_\lambda$. Fix $\lambda_0\in I$ such that $S_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and let $X_{\lambda_0}$ and $Y_{\lambda_0}$ be schemes of finite presentation over $S_{\lambda_0}$. Put $X_\lambda=X_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S_\lambda$, $Y_\lambda=Y_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S_\lambda$, $X=X_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S$, and $Y=Y_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S$, with the canonical projections of [def-nagata-basechanged-system], and let $\varphi\colon X\to Y$ be an $S$-morphism. Make the finite affine covers, descended opens, affine refinements, generator and relation lifts, rebased comparison maps, and finite overlap-equality witnesses fixed by [def-nagata-morphism-descent]; let $\lambda_\varphi=u(F)$ and let $\varphi_{\lambda_\varphi}\colon X_{\lambda_\varphi}\to Y_{\lambda_\varphi}$ be the glued morphism defined there. Then the base change of $\varphi_{\lambda_\varphi}$ along $S\to S_{\lambda_\varphi}$ is the given morphism $\varphi$.

proof.text: Use chart_eq and naturality of baseChangeCone to identify the inverse image of every transported chart with limitChart. Pull back NagataMorphismDescentData.charts_cover to obtain a cover of the limit source. The open-descent part of the construction has already been encapsulated in charts_cover.

proof.text: On a limit chart restrict the final-stage projection to its chart, then compose with toCoefficient. The equations toCoefficient_eq and coefficientTransition_eq, cone naturality and cancellation of the generator-chart open immersion identify its composite with coefficientTransition as limitToGenerator. localOver, targetOver, limitMap_eq, limitOver and the pullback equations show that this local map and limitMap have the same map to T_j. The equations localGenerators, coefficientLift_eq and generatorLift_eq give equality on the presentation generators. Cancel the surjective evaluation map of presentation.toGenerators, then use MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext on coefficients and variables to obtain equality of maps on global sections. Mathlib ext_of_isAffine gives equality of the local scheme morphisms.

On the limit cover, compare its first pullback projection using mapAt_fst and the equality of local morphisms from Step 2; compare its second projection using mapAt_snd, naturality of baseChangeCone, and limitOver. Apply pullback.hom_ext on each chart and Scheme.Cover.hom_ext on their cover.

blueprint_update.statement:
The base change of the constructed
$\varphi_{\lambda_\varphi}$ to $S$ is $\varphi$.

proof.text:
The inverse-image opens pull back to the original opens by the quasi-compact
open descent property. On each affine piece, the descended ring map pulls
back to the original map by the affine finite-presentation property. The
selected equality stages make those local maps agree on all overlaps, so
their gluing pulls back to the gluing of the original local maps, namely
$\varphi$.
